info.title: Avi Cluster Object API
info.description:
Avi Cluster object api
```
- configure cluster
- show cluster
```

API permission: PERMISSION_CONTROLLER

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: object name

parameters.name: refers_to
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that refers to another Avi resource. Its syntax is refers_to=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all virtual services referring to pool p1 will be refers_to=pool:pool_p1_uuid

parameters.name: referred_by
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that are referred by another Avi resource. Its syntax is referred_by=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all pools referred_by virtual service vs1 - referred_by=virtualservice:vs_vs1_uuid

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of fields to be returned for the resource. Some fields like name, URL, uuid etc. are always returned.

parameters.name: include_name
parameters.description: All the Avi REST reference URIs have a name suffix as URI#name. It is useful to get the referenced resource name without performing get on that object.

parameters.name: skip_default
parameters.description: Default values are not set.

parameters.name: join_subresources
parameters.description: It automatically returns additional dependent resources like runtime. Eg. join_subresources=runtime.

parameters.name: X-Avi-Tenant
parameters.description: Avi Tenant Header

parameters.name: X-Avi-Tenant-UUID
parameters.description: Avi Tenant Header UUID

parameters.name: X-Avi-Version
parameters.description: The caller is required to set Avi Version Header to the expected version of configuration. The response from the controller will provide and accept data according to the specified version. The controller will reject POST and PUT requests where the data is not compatible with the specified version.

parameters.name: X-CSRFToken
parameters.description: Avi Controller may send back CSRF token in the response cookies. The caller should update the request headers with this token else controller will reject requests.

name.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

nodes.description: Minimum of 1 items required. Maximum of 7 items allowed. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

rejoin_nodes_automatically.description: Re-join cluster nodes automatically in the event one of the node is reset to factory. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

tenant_ref.description: It is a reference to an object of type Tenant. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

uuid.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

virtual_ip.description: A V4 virtual IP address for the Cluster that always points to the V4 IP of the leader node in Cluster. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

virtual_ip6.description: A V6 virtual IP address for the Cluster that always points to the V6 IP of the leader node in Cluster. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

categories.description: Optional service categories that a node can be assigned (e.g. SYSTEM, INFRASTRUCTURE or ANALYTICS). Field introduced in 18.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

interfaces.description: Interface details of the controller node. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

ip.description: V4 IP address of controller VM. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

ip6.description: V6 IP address of controller VM. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

name.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

password.description: The password we will use when authenticating with this node (Not persisted). Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

public_ip_or_name.description: Public IP address or hostname of the controller VM. Field introduced in 17.2.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

static_routes.description: Static routes configured on the controller node. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

vm_hostname.description: Hostname assigned to this controller VM. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

vm_mor.description: Managed object reference of this controller VM. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

vm_name.description: Name of the controller VM. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

vm_uuid.description: UUID on the controller VM. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

gateway.description: IPv4 default gateway of the interface. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

gateway6.description: IPv6 default gateway of the interface. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

if_name.description: Interface name. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

ip.description: IPv4 prefix of the interface. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

ip6.description: IPv6 prefix of the interface. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

labels.description: Interface label like mgmt, secure channel or HSM. Enum options - MGMT, SE_SECURE_CHANNEL, HSM. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

mac_address.description: Mac address of interface. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

mode.description: IPv4 address mode DHCP/STATIC. Enum options - DHCP, STATIC, VIP, DOCKER_HOST, MODE_MANUAL. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

mode6.description: IPv6 address mode STATIC. Enum options - DHCP, STATIC, VIP, DOCKER_HOST, MODE_MANUAL. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

public_ip_or_name.description: Public IP of interface. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

v4_enabled.description: Enable V4 IP on this interface. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

v6_enabled.description: Enable V6 IP on this interface. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

addr.description: IP address. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

type.description: Enum options - V4, DNS, V6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

ip_addr.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

mask.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

key.description: Key. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

value.description: Value. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

disable_gateway_monitor.description: Disable the gateway monitor for default gateway. They are monitored by default. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

if_name.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.
